      Problem: When no consolidator markers are found and REVIEW_PARSER_FAILOPEN=1 (default), the script does not empty the output file or exit; it continues into anchor coverage logic and emits passthrough blocks. This violates the documented fail-open contract which requires an empty review_issues.txt so the editor can fall back to the raw reviewer bundle.; The fail-open path should degrade gracefully by producing empty advisory output when the consolidator output is unusable. Instead it generates non-empty passthrough blocks containing every anchor from the raw bundle, defeating the fallback and potentially causing the editor to act on duplicate, unconsolidated findings.; ISSUE 2

  [13] File: `scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh`
      Problem: AWK regex constants use unescaped forward slashes `/` inside character classes: `match(line, /...[./-].../, hit)`.; In AWK, `/` is the regex delimiter. While many modern implementations tolerate `/` inside a bracket expression `[...]`, some stricter or older AWK versions may interpret the `/` as the end of the regex constant, leading to syntax errors or truncated pattern matching. This could cause the parser to miss anchors for files in subdirectories.; ### Hardening Suggestions
      Confidence: avg 4.0
